Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) indicated for prostate cancer. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (from drug_indication.efo_id), indication_label (from drug_indication.efo_term), and max_phase_for_ind. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno, then INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter drug_indication.efo_term or mesh_heading for prostate cancer. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
